title: Forget AI coding agents. Give me an AI marketing department.
author: ZymzAlchemy
selftext:
I can write code.

I can make the art.

I need an AI that wakes up every morning and goes:

**"I clipped your gameplay, made the Short, posted it everywhere, answered three comments, contacted six creators, and somehow got you mentioned by IGN. Go make the damn game."**

*That's* the agentic future I'm waiting for.

comments.author: Bluetails_Buizel
comments.body: lol, nice idea! That’s a real space ai needs to fill, other than art!

replies.author: ZymzAlchemy
replies.body: First one that gets there will make a fortune

replies.author: fusionliberty796
replies.body: It's already possible. Have you seen munder diflin? Helps to have your own custom game engine so you can create all the necessary api locally. . I'm turning the lights on once my dgx cluster ready

replies.author: ZymzAlchemy
replies.body: Nicely done. I'm nearing game completion so marketing is my next hurdle, this will be my first published game. I was just making games for my kid and I for fun and figured I'd give it a shot.

comments.author: oadephon
comments.body:
The problem is, when marketing is that easy, everyone will do it that way, and so it'll be worthless to do it that way.

Probably, in order to survive, the internet will have to create spaces which verify the humanity of posters somehow, because the level of slop in the scenario you're describing will kill all regular platforms.

replies.author: Varrianda
replies.body: I think it’s kind of a paradox. If marketing gets easy, then marketing gets harder. And by that I mean, if everyone can publish high quality shorts and advertisements then the bar goes way up.

comments.author: NovaGuarda
comments.body:
Marketing is about making people aware of something. Posting on Reddit about a product is marketing. If you can do hard things like art and code, something simple like social media ads should be easy peasy. 

People see trash every day, make something that stands out. There's art in that.

replies.author: ZymzAlchemy
replies.body:
I get where you’re coming from. My days are already pretty full, and finding time for coding and art is hard enough without trying to keep up with the social media treadmill.

My wife and son are both disabled, so even though I’m retired, a lot of my time goes toward taking care of my family and handling real-life responsibilities.

The game gets whatever time is left. Not much room left for marketing it, but I'm working on a strategy as the game nears completion.

replies.author: ZymzAlchemy
replies.body: IGN. It’s where we got gaming news before you kids started getting yours from a guy screaming into a ring light. 😂

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: I have about half of this running at the moment. Metricool + their MCP gets you a good chunk of the way there if you have a system for generating or clipping content.

comments.author: god-damn-the-usa
comments.body: if that existed, everyone would be using it, and the internet would be filled with slop content and bot replies and everyone would stop using it or you'd have so much competition that it wouldn't matter

replies.author: ZymzAlchemy
replies.body: So it would be just like now. 🤪😁

replies.author: ZymzAlchemy
replies.body:
I was managing long before the Internet was around, I'm sure if it collapsed tonight we'd all figure it out just fine. 

Be well.

Distribution is the new moat this is true,

replies.body: Unfortunately I have more technical background than I care too lol. I'll give that a peek, ty.

comments.body: You could realistically build something like that now

replies.author: ZymzAlchemy
replies.body: That's what I'm finding out so this has been quite useful.

comments.author: Duet_Yourself
comments.body:
I’m actually working on this and getting closer.

https://www.marketstand.org

Using it for my site https://www.sensipets.com

I have it so only I can login. But have it connected to the repo, analytics platform, marketing APIs, and more. Biggest issue I’m encountering is creating systems to best understand approved audiences, which ad platforms to focus on, and how to evaluate the outcome of run campaigns.

Right now it:  
\- scrapes your site for content, brand, assets  
\- finds competitors in the space  
\- identifies features that are differentiators  
\- suggests for approval audiences/copy/landing pages  
\- proposes campaigns for meta, Reddit, google

comments.body: The tech already exists, and people are using it for that purpose as well. AIs entire purpose is to cover your deficits, whatever they may be. Go read up on autonomous agentic workflows on locallama and set up some to do what you need. Or, I guess, wait until someone creates a one click solution, whenever that may be.
